accepted.quote: Committee Democrats do not dispute that there are barriers in the way of deploying broadband infrastructure. H.R. 2289 addresses none of them, unfortunately.
accepted.rationale: Pallone states that H.R. 2289 fails to address barriers to broadband infrastructure deployment.

accepted.quote: H.R. 2289 regrettably proposes to eliminate standard environmental and historic preservation protections that simply do not affect the overwhelming majority of communications infrastructure projects as suggested by Republicans.
accepted.rationale: Pallone opposes eliminating environmental and historic preservation protections and defends existing review for communications projects.
